recordGrain: one current Hrvatska pošta postcode assignment and its explicitly linked DGU delivery-office area or a truthful unavailable result

m2Definition.definition: A current rights-cleared Hrvatska pošta nationwide five-digit assignment denominator and either a DGU delivery-office-area Polygon/MultiPolygon joined by an explicit versioned operator-office-to-DGU identifier crosswalk or a rights-cleared postcode-membership-derived surface are pinned by edition, validity, terms, CRS, SHA-256, coverage, members, exclusions, method and uncertainty, published as an approved immutable artifact, and pass the real HR loader, API and app search-to-translucent-area path. Public operator downloads without a reuse grant, request-priced DGU releases without approved rights and a crosswalk, GISCO or GeoNames points, NUTS or administrative matches, address, building or parcel geometry, buffers, Voronoi cells, synthetic fixtures, and invented route, PO box or organization surfaces never satisfy M2.

officialObservations.finding: Hrvatska pošta lists Excel and XML downloads for settlement-to-destination-office assignments, postal offices, Zagreb streets-to-destination-office assignments and parcel lockers. The page exposes no Polygon/MultiPolygon release or product-specific reuse grant. Data files were not downloaded because the linked legal notice limits copying and redistribution without express consent.

The current notice limits site content to private, non-commercial and individual use and prohibits copying, modification, transmission or distribution without Hrvatska pošta's express consent. No consent, contract, authenticated access or data-file download occurred.

DGU states that its register includes delivery-office areas and a graphical component in HTRS96/TM, with XML list and SHP graphical delivery. The same page states that use is priced and issued by request under the cited regulation. No request, payment, licence acceptance, release download or operator-office crosswalk occurred.

The current service catalogue exposes anonymous INSPIRE Address and Administrative Unit ATOM feeds and registered WMS access, but it does not expose the delivery-office-area register as an anonymous reusable postcode polygon release. Address and administrative geometry remain separate authorities and no feature rows were queried.

GISCO describes a postal-code point dataset under CC BY-SA 4.0. Non-geographic codes are excluded and omissions or incorrect locations may exist; points are not Hrvatska pošta or DGU postal-area perimeters.
The current index identifies Postal codes 2025 with reference date 2025-01-01.
Postal codes 2025 was released 2026-04-14 and received location and island-assignment corrections 2026-06-19.

The Croatia row records zero member-state postal-dataset codes, 289 address-derived codes, 24 GeoNames codes, zero GISCO-2020 carryovers and 354 manually located or geocoded codes, totalling 667. It does not establish Hrvatska pošta completeness or any postal polygon.
The ZIP contains one CSV with only NUTS3 and CODE columns. It has 667 unique five-digit codes after stripping the documented single-quote text wrapper and no coordinates or geometry.

dataQuality.risk: The 667-row TERCET crosswalk is internally unique and format-valid after quote normalization, but it is not a current Hrvatska pošta assignment denominator and contains no geometry. The operator's current downloadable lists lack reusable redistribution rights, while the DGU delivery-office areas require a request, pricing terms and an explicit operator-office crosswalk.

browserReview.reason: No real rights-cleared HR Polygon/MultiPolygon exists to exercise. Deterministic shared UI tests verify capability without presenting synthetic geometry as Croatian M2 evidence.

pdfReview.finding: The visible table headers and Croatia row match the extracted 0, 289, 24, 0, 354 and 667 values without clipping or overlap.

visualizationDecision.reason: An exact authority and geometry audit matrix communicates the one-country evidence more faithfully than a chart, and no spatial surface exists to map.

blockerSummary: Hrvatska pošta exposes current assignment downloads but its legal notice does not permit AGID redistribution without express consent. DGU confirms official graphical delivery-office areas, but the release is request- and price-controlled and no explicit operator-office-to-DGU identifier crosswalk or reusable release was obtained. The public TERCET artifact has 667 valid codes but no geometry and no member-state postal-dataset rows.

Pin CRS, coverage, validity, terms, attribution and SHA-256, publish an approved immutable artifact without personal, cadastral or land-right data, and preserve official, derived, virtual and unavailable classifications.
